title: Breakfast for Six on One Griddle
constraints: one oven on its lowest setting
notes: The griddle is a strict queue: bacon, scrape, three pancake passes, a temperature drop, then the eggs. The three passes are three steps because the source names three durations. The warm oven is a holding resource with a variable duration that runs until the call. Serve is the compound all-trigger the text spells out (eggs, toast, coffee).
